content:
Apple has recently raised prices on several products, but is also promoting two ways for consumers to save money when purchasing new hardware: sales tax holidays and back-to-school promotions.

Sales tax holidays and back-to-school promotions are the two ways Apple is currently offering savings opportunities for new hardware purchases.

If you're looking to buy a new Apple product, Apple is currently promoting two money-saving options on Apple.com.

This summer, several U.S. states will hold sales tax holidays on designated dates. Alabama's promotion has already ended last weekend, but nine other states are still ongoing, including:

  • Arkansas: August 1–2
  • Florida: July 20–August 20
  • Massachusetts: August 8–9
  • Missouri: August 7–9
  • New Mexico: July 31–August 2
  • South Carolina: August 7–9
  • Tennessee: July 31–August 2
  • Virginia: August 7–9
  • West Virginia: July 31–August 3

The specific terms of each state's sales tax holiday vary; details can be found here. Tax-free purchases of new Apple products can save a significant amount, especially in states with higher exemption thresholds.

Apple is also running back-to-school promotions on select Mac and iPad models.

From now through August 27, eligible buyers (including students and educators) who purchase a new Mac or iPad will receive a gift card valued at up to $150.

The MacBook Pro is the only product eligible for the full $150 Apple gift card. Purchases of the MacBook Air, iPad Pro, or iPad Air will receive a $100 gift card.

Depending on the product you're interested in, you may find better prices elsewhere. For example, Amazon currently has promotions on Apple products including:

  • AirTag 2 four-pack: $89 (originally $99)
  • AirPods Pro 3: $199 (originally $249)
  • Apple Watch Series 11: $299 (originally $399)
  • AirPods Max 2: $449 (originally $549)

Where do you usually find deals on Apple products? Feel free to share in the comments.
